title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-21
content:
Purpose: prep notes and follow-ups for Exec Staff sync 2026-03-21 (30m). Goal is to align on immediate operational risks, a small set of decisions, and clear owners for action items.

Attendees: CEO, COO, CTO, Head of Product, Head of Eng, Head of SRE, Head of Sales (summary notes to circulate)

Top-level agenda (time boxed):
- 0-5m: Quick wins / shoutouts / urgent escalations
- 5-15m: Operational risks that need exec attention (capacity, Dedicated customer incident, Private compliance timeline)
- 15-25m: Roadmap decision(s) — one-off tradeoffs for Q2 launches (Optimize feature gating, Dedicated scaling policy change)
- 25-30m: Review action items and owners

Notes / Background / Things to surface
1) Capacity & Dedicated pool utilization
- Observed a 20% spike in p99 latency for GPU pool 3 during last week’s E2E tests. Rerun scheduled by release-eng. Implications for SLAs if this recurs during peak.
- Consider temporary routing policy to fallback to compatible model variant for a subset of traffic until root cause fixed.
- Linked: confluence://infra/gpu-pools/incident-2026-03-18, JIRA-PRJ-1287

2) Major Dedicated customer (FinCorp) incident follow-up
- Root cause: unexpected KV cache eviction pattern + autoscaler miscalculation under short bursts. Customer impact: 6-min outage, partial retries.
- Status: fixes merged to canary; SRE schedule rolling patch next 24h. Need exec-level note to FinCorp? Customer success recommends proactive outreach + 1:1 with FinCorp CTO.

3) Private deploy / Compliance (EU banking) timeline
- Legal says additional audit controls requested; target go-live pushed from May 1 to May 21 to accommodate SOC review. Ask: do we accept slip and communicate to pilot customers, or pull additional resources to keep date?
- Risk: compressing audit work could surface noncompliance and jeopardize contract. Recommendation: accept slip + offer alpha access to low-risk pilot customers.

4) Product roadmap asks for Q2 gating decision
- Feature: Optimize — automated batching suggestions + profiling UI. Product asks to ship Beta to hosted API by Apr 15. Requires small infra investment (2 N4 GPU weeks) and staging validation.
- Tradeoff: if we allocate infra to Optimize, slower rollout for new model compilation kernel for long-seq optimization. Propose canary split: prioritize Optimize for hosted API with limited cohort.

5) Hiring / org items
- Proposal to convert one IC infra role to senior SRE (urgent) — CVs in hire queue. Need approval to expedite.
- Headcount delta and budget impact summary attached (see linked Confluence).

Open questions for exec input
- Approve temporary routing fallback to model-variant for 10% of Dedicated traffic? (COO/CTO)
- Approve acceptance of Private deploy slip to May 21? (CEO/Legal)
- Approve reallocation of infra short-term budget for Optimize Beta? (CFO/Head of Product)

Action items (explicit owners and dates)
- A1: SRE to finalize canary patch and start rolling fix for Dedicated incident. Owner: Connor Blake. Due: 2026-03-22.
- A2: Customer Success to draft proactive outreach note to FinCorp and set 1:1 with their CTO. Owner: Mei Chen. Due: 2026-03-21 EOD.
- A3: Release Eng to run extended GPU pool stress test and report p99 back to execs. Owner: Ravi Singh. Due: 2026-03-23.
- A4: Product to produce one-page tradeoff memo for Optimize Beta vs kernel rollout. Owner: Head of Product. Due: 2026-03-24 (for leadership decision).
- A5: People Ops / Hiring to expedite SRE conversion and provide compensation plan. Owner: Head of Eng. Due: 2026-03-28.
- A6: Legal to confirm audit scope and sign-off timeline for Private deploy. Owner: Legal (named contact TBD). Due: 2026-03-25.

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep meeting tight; surface only two ask decisions max. Execs prefer micro-decisions with clear cost/benefit.
- Bring short summary slide (1 slide) with visuals: a) capacity trend (p95/p99), b) customer impact timeline, c) recommended decision + upside/downside.
- If CEO pushes to accelerate Private deploy, have contingency: propose pilot beta with two low-risk customers instead of full go-live.

Follow-ups after the meeting
- Send meeting recap + action items in Slack channel #exec-notes and update Confluence page.
- Tag owners in Jira tickets (I will create tickets for A1-A6 after meeting).

Draft outreach language for FinCorp (to be refined by CS):
"Apologies for the disruption earlier this week. We identified the root cause and have a rolling patch in canary; SRE expects a full fix within 24 hours. We’d like to set up a 30-min technical postmortem with your team to walk through remediation and compensating controls. Thanks for bearing with us — we take this seriously and want to restore full confidence."

Misc / rough brainstorm (notes to self)
- Consider short-term pricing credit for FinCorp if SLA breach confirmed. Finance input required.
- Double-check whether autoscaler fix affects Dedicated pricing model (quota calculations).

Done checklist before meeting
- [ ] Export p99 graph from observability (Ravi)
- [ ] One-slide summary slide (Ava)
- [ ] Confirm CS note to FinCorp (Mei)
